verdict.rationale: Morph's own Reflexes feature lets you send labeled examples, run a training job, and then classify text against the resulting model on the same API. That is training on your own data and serving the result in one place, but only for small text classifiers. Nothing documents fine-tuning the open-weight chat models, and dedicated endpoints only reserve capacity for stock models. Missing for 10: fine-tuning of supported base/chat models (e.g., Kimi K3), serving fine-tuned chat models via chat completions or dedicated endpoints, details on training data formats and hyperparameters, independent corroboration.
